# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.1.8 for Windows

- Tracks no longer fail with “waveform time axis differs from the template” when rekordbox’s own waveform data disagrees by a few points.
- AIFF files whose header overstates their size, as some tag editors leave them, now process normally. Files with audio that is actually cut short are still refused.
- When a USB’s stem list is full, OverCue now stops before processing each new track and explains how to make room, instead of failing after separation.
